global-energy-consumption-per-person.alt: Stacked bars of energy use per person in gigajoules per year for four invented countries from less to more developed: A 15 (10 biomass, 5 fossil fuels), B 40 (8 biomass, 30 fossil fuels, 2 other), C 110 (4 biomass, 92 fossil fuels, 14 other), D 230 (5 biomass, 185 fossil fuels, 40 other). Invented data for practice.
